# Third-party assets (D-033)

Everything in this folder is free to use in commercial games and is committed to the repository.

| Asset | Author | Licence | Source | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KayKit Adventurers Character Pack 1.0 (Knight, Barbarian, Mage, Rogue, Rogue Hooded + props) | Kay Lousberg | CC0 | github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Adventures-1.0 | every person in the world, and the figurines on the table |
| Minstrel Dance, The Bard's Tale, King's Feast, The Old Tower Inn | RandomMind | CC0 | opengameart.org | music (village, road, halls, table) |
| Casino Audio, RPG Audio, UI Audio | Kenney (kenney.nl) | CC0 | kenney.nl/assets | table, coin, door, footstep and menu sounds |

Credit is not required by CC0; it is kept here because it is right.

## Asset Store packs (not in the repository)

These are licensed to the creative director's Unity account through the Asset Store EULA, which does not allow
publishing them in a public repository. They live in `Assets/Art`, `Assets/Audio`, `Assets/Terrain`,
`Assets/TerrainTexturesPackFree`, `Assets/Polytope Studio`, `Assets/ithappy` (all ignored by Git) and are
imported from Package Manager > My Assets. Builds may contain them; the repository may not.

| Pack | Publisher | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| Fantasy Kingdom (URP) | Unity Technologies | houses, halls, trees, bushes, ground plants, terrain textures, ambience |
| Terrain Textures Pack Free | (Asset Store) | grass and stone terrain layers |
| Lowpoly Environment - Nature Free | Polytope Studio | fruit and pine trees, rocks, ore, logs, fences, flowers |
| Cute Furniture Free | ithappy | clock, pictures, lamps, armchair and books in the Champion's Hall |
